scope.definition: Currently compiled event IDs; supporting old cards are context.

summary: Accepted with two small calendar-context fixes after re-reading all 25 current kit/shop cards. All six earlier kit findings are repaired, including the spoon promise, visible tuning cost, valuation trade, compliment alignment and both shop setups.

issues.problem: The first market setup always says the square is all stalls this morning, but the place card has no time/slot gate and can first be drawn on an afternoon or evening village visit.
issues.fix: Use slot-neutral wording for the recurring market, or restrict this specifically morning version and preserve an appropriate counter for later visits.

issues.problem: Let them come to lectures always puts the silver bees through a live Astromancy lecture. The ownership/season gate excludes winter but not summer breaks spent at the castle, when the ambient card can still be dealt and ordinary classes are suspended.
issues.fix: Require term for the lecture version, or give the break version an activity the player can actually attend.
